newsitem.title: JAPAN: LME's King has no comment on EU capital proposal.
newsitem.headline: LME's King has no comment on EU capital proposal.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) Chief Executive David King on Tuesday declined to comment on news that the European Commission is to propose rules that could force British commodities trade houses to increase capital.
"I'm aware of that proposal but am not going to make a specific comment at this stage," King told Reuters in a telephone interview. "I don't think it's appropriate (to comment)."

The European Commission is expected to propose rules on Wednesday that could force British commodities trading houses to increase capital to cover market risks, industry and commission officials said on Monday.
Although the proposal is not targeted at Britain, it would particularly affect the London commodity markets, where some 95 percent of the EU's commodity business is conducted.
King is currently visiting Japan for a meeting of the International World Copper Council (IWCC).
